question: Which state government launched the Matrushakti Udaymita Scheme to provide support to women entrepreneurs?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Haryana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **state government of Haryana** launched the **Matrushakti Udaymita Scheme** to provide support to **women entrepreneurs**.
 
• The Haryana **"Matrushakti Udyamita Scheme"** was unveiled by **Chief Minister Manohar Lal Khattar** to** assist women in starting their own businesses**.
 
• The **main goal** of this scheme is to **support female entrepreneurs** in all types of businesses, trades, and enterprises.
 
• In addition, he announced the** "Sushma Swaraj Award"**, which comes with a **5 lakh rupee prize**.
 
• Under the **Matrushakti Udyamita Scheme**, anyone who wants to start their own business, trade, or venture will be** able to access soft loans from financial institutions**, according to the government.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Central Government and State Governments of India **created **Women Empowerment Schemes** to **empower women**.
 
• **Providing equal access to resources, opportunities, decision-making authority, and capacity building for women of all ages** is referred to as **"women empowerment"**.
 
• **Education, skill development, more work options, etc.** can all **contribute** to the empowerment of women. 
 
• **Women's access to education, financial aid, and employment possibilities are the main goals** of women empowerment schemes. These initiatives also **seek to advance the health and happiness of women**.
